name: smwgraphics-super-bonk-juicy-jungle
title: Super Bonk - Juicy Jungle
description:
It's the BG seen where Bonk is in a giant house that belongs to a dinosaur. There are enemies slightly bigger than Bonk.
You can edit the back area color, it consumes nearly a GFX file and palette can be edited.
Recommended scrolling: both horizontal and vertical scrolling set to variable.
Credit isn't needed.
